title: crepidium distans
intro: Crepidium distans, commonly known as the "gulma", is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Crepidium distans include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit anti-viral and anti-bacterial activities, and show potential in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections; its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
